note: The 60 s scripted timeline for the Phase 4 budget gate. Regenerate with: node tools/make-timeline.mjs --script tests/fixtures/timeline-budget-60s.script.json --summary
_design_comment: DRIVEN HARD ON PURPOSE. A budget test measured over a quiet passage certifies
nothing: the whole point is the p99, and the 99th percentile frame is a frame where
everything is firing at once. So the bands sit high, flux and percussivity sit high,
and the event list stacks onsets, chord changes and novelty pulses on top of each
other rather than spacing them out politely.
Every field that drives a COST is pushed up rather than centred:
bass/sub high      -> feedbackZoom and warpAmount at the top of their mapped range
flux/percussivity  -> particle emission and the bolt motif
novelty            -> fractalMorph, which raises the fractal iteration count
onset              -> the bolt motif, an extra full-screen pass when it fires
chromaFlux         -> the rose motif, another full-screen pass
bpmConf is above the 0.35 floor throughout, so the phase-locked path runs rather
60 s at 60 fps is 3600 frames, which makes the p99 the 36th worst frame — enough
samples for the percentile to mean something and short enough to run on a whim.
_events_comment: Novelty every 6 s so fractalMorph is exercised ten times over the run, and the
governor — if it steps at all — has to make that decision more than once. The three
stacked clusters at 20 s, 40 s and 55 s fire novelty, chromaFlux and onset on the
same frame: that is the frame the p99 is about.
